lines.en: Come in. This is my little studio.
Wow, Grandma! Is this your canvas?
Yes. I painted this flower this morning.
lines.ko: 네. 오늘 아침에 이 꽃을 그렸어요.

lines.en: It's beautiful. Do you enjoy painting?
I enjoy it very much. Art makes me happy.
lines.ko: 아주 즐거워요. 미술은 저를 행복하게 해요.

lines.en: What is this? It looks like a sketch.
That's a sketch for my next oil painting.
Will you put it in a frame?
Yes, I will frame it next week.
lines.ko: 네, 다음 주에 액자에 넣을 거예요.

lines.en: Thank you for showing me, Grandma.
Excuse me. I need a new brush.
Sure, Ma'am. What kind of brush do you want?
A simple one for oil painting, please.
This one is good. Do you need a palette?
Yes. My old palette broke last week.
Here is a new one. Do you need a canvas?
Yes, a small canvas. I'm going to paint flowers.
lines.ko: 네, 작은 캔버스요. 꽃을 그릴 거예요.

lines.en: Flowers are nice. Do you enjoy art, Ma'am?
I do. I painted every day when I was young.
lines.ko: 네. 젊었을 때는 매일 그림을 그렸어요.

lines.en: That's great. Thank you. Enjoy your painting.
